column_description: A SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each communication record.
A VARCHAR(70) foreign key referencing Equipment(EquipmentCode), linking communication data to a specific piece of equipment.
An INTEGER foreign key referencing Location(LocationRegistry) for associating the communication system with a location (e.g., a station).
A REAL value specifying the radio communication frequency in MHz.
An enum (AntennaStatus_enum) indicating the antenna’s operational state (e.g., Error, Normal, Warning).
An enum (BluetoothStatus_enum) indicating the Bluetooth status (e.g., On, Error, Off, Pairing).
An INTEGER optionally referencing OperationMaintenance(OpMaintRegistry) for maintenance or operational records tied to communication gear.

JSONB column. Combines signal strength and performance metrics for various communication systems.
